title: Group-Project Schedule
description: Input for scripts/generate-schedule.js. Deadlines are anchored to final_deadline: the agent (or the generator with --compute-deadlines) derives intermediate deadlines from final_deadline − today — each task's deadline = today + (complexityWeight / maxWeight) × (window × 0.8), so easy tasks (L1=1) get short deadlines and heavy tasks (L3=3) get extended ones. All intermediate deadlines lie strictly between today and final_deadline.

title.description: Title shown in the dark-red title bar, e.g., 'KẾ HOẠCH LÀM VIỆC NHÓM 3 – MIS'

subtitle.description: Optional subtitle/instruction line under the title.

today.description: Anchor date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to the generation date when omitted.

final_deadline.description: Hard outer bound (YYYY-MM-DD). Required when any task relies on computed deadlines.

final_deadline_time.description: Optional time text for the final deadline string, e.g., '23h00 ngày 29/05/2026'.

phases.description: Ordered phases; each renders as a navy merged phase-header row followed by its task rows.

name.description: Phase header text, e.g., 'Giai đoạn 1 – Tổng quan, lý thuyết và phân tích hiện trạng'.

nhiemVu.description: Nhiệm vụ / role group label (bold, often merged vertically).

task.description: Task cụ thể — specific deliverable description.

pic.description: PIC name(s). Array renders as comma-joined.

deadline.description: Explicit deadline string, e.g., '23h59 ngày 20/04/2026'. When omitted, computed from final_deadline − today by complexity.

deadline_time.description: Time-of-day prefix for computed deadlines, e.g., '23h59'. Default '23h59'.

complexity.description: L1 easy = 1, L2 medium = 2, L3 heavy = 3 weight for deadline allocation. Required for computed deadlines.

notes.description: Notes, e.g., dependency 'Chọn phần này thì viết luôn phần ID 14'.

highlight.description: true → full row yellow fill FFFFD966 (priority/vote rows).

milestone.description: true → full row red fill FFFF0000, white bold text (final submission / milestone).
